participation.context: Accepted the two orders, and refused a date and a house.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Gave the orders, and would not add the house to them.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

relations.note: two orders, and no house at a door
relations.quote: Mend the back. And when you write, say something.

story.body: You heard the back and the writing as the whole of the errand. You did not turn the door into a bargain about the house.

relations.note: two orders, and no house at a door

title: Heard Anne say mend the back and write
